page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number at left, heading centred below it. Centre: engraving (emblem picture). Below it: four centred verse lines. Right, below the verse: catchword "Breui-". No margin notes.

main_text.head: EMBLEMA. RESPICE FINEM.
main_text.l: Nil Pullata iuuat quæ Carmina Præfica cantet,
Nil post Fata iuuant aliorum munera, censusq;
Alma fides, Pietas atq; præacta[?] iuuant.

page.notes: The engraving shows two swans facing each other on either side of an upright arrow, rising from an hourglass standing on a grassy ground with hills behind. It has no printed text. The verse is set in italic type. The word "præacta" in the last line is doubtful; the scan is faint there. The page number is partly obscured by a blot at the left.
